name: Test machines
description: The shared test machines for the agents: a queue each machine, screenshots, input, commands, apps, files and recordings, through bb's test-machines, ssh, adb, WebDriverAgent, or a demo machine.

settings.title: Swarm's machines
settings.description: The computers joined to Swarm, their screens: macOS, Windows and Linux.

settings.title: This computer
settings.description: The screen of the computer Swarm runs on.

settings.title: Machines of bb's test-machines
settings.description: The machines bb's test-machines plugin has (a Mac, a Linux desktop, a Windows VM, phones), through its command line, where bb runs beside Swarm. In a bb thread they take its turn; elsewhere the plugin waits while bb's queue has a machine.

settings.title: Machines over ssh
settings.description: id:kind:user@host, comma-separated: commands and files, and a Mac's screenshots and input.

settings.title: Android phones through adb
settings.description: The phones and emulators adb lists: screenshots, taps, apps, logs. Turn off bb's machines if bb has the same phones, so that each has one line.

settings.title: Where the phones are plugged in
settings.description: A computer joined to Swarm (its name), or an ssh target, whose adb runs for the plugin, when the phones aren't plugged into this computer.

settings.title: Names of the phones
settings.description: id:serial, comma-separated: the id agents call a phone by. Unnamed ones go by their serial.

settings.title: Phones not used
settings.description: Serials of the Android phones the plugin leaves out, though adb lists them: those you stopped using on the Settings page.

settings.title: iPhones through WebDriverAgent
settings.description: id:UDID of each iPhone, whose WebDriverAgent the plugin builds and runs on the Mac it's plugged into; or id:URL[@UDID] of one you run yourself.

settings.title: The Mac the iPhones are plugged into
settings.description: The Mac the iPhones are plugged into: one joined to Swarm (its name), or an ssh target. WebDriverAgent is asked from there, and installs go through its devicectl.

settings.title: Your Apple developer team
settings.description: The Team ID WebDriverAgent is signed with, for the plugin to build and run it on your iPhones.

settings.title: A demo machine
settings.description: A machine of the plugin's own, a screen in memory, for trying the tools.

settings.title: Phones you carry
settings.description: Machine ids, comma-separated, of phones you carry: there agents only install and uninstall your test builds and read their logs. Nothing else, not even a screenshot.

settings.title: Your test builds
settings.description: The package or bundle ids, comma-separated (* for any part), of the builds agents may uninstall and read the logs of on a phone you carry.

settings.title: More apps agents stay out of
settings.description: Names or ids, comma-separated, besides the ones agents always stay out of (passwords, banking and payments, mail, messages, photos, health, the car, social posting, shopping).

settings.title: Machines you took
settings.description: Kept by the plugin: the machines you took for yourself, still yours after it restarts.

tools.name: machine_status
tools.title: Machines' status
tools.description: Who has each test machine, who's waiting, and what each is. Never waits and needs no turn. live: also ask the machine's driver how it is.

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

live.description: Also ask the machine how it is (a few seconds).

tools.name: machine_take
tools.title: Take a machine
tools.description: Wait in line for a test machine and hold it without running anything yet, saying what it's for. Use before a sequence of steps you don't want interleaved with another thread's. Every other machine_* tool takes your turn by itself; your turn ends with your turn of the conversation.

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line in this call if another thread has the machine (default 4; 0 to not wait). When it runs out, your place in line is kept 3 minutes for your next call.

tools.name: machine_release
tools.title: Release a machine
tools.description: Give a test machine back now, for the next in line (all of yours when none is named). Your turn ending gives them back anyway.

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

tools.name: machine_capture
tools.title: Screenshot a machine
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a test machine's screen and look at it. Needs no turn. Returns the image at the screen's own pixels, which are what machine_drive takes. show: also save it, and give a Markdown image line to put in your reply, which shows it in the thread.

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

show.description: Show it to the user: a Markdown image line to put in your reply.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line in this call if another thread has the machine (default 4; 0 to not wait). When it runs out, your place in line is kept 3 minutes for your next call.

tools.name: machine_describe
tools.title: Read a machine's screen
tools.description: What's on a test machine's screen as named elements (buttons, fields, links, text) and the point to click each, in screenshot pixels: cheaper and surer than reading a screenshot to find where to click. Needs no turn. Android through uiautomator, iPhones through WebDriverAgent, a Mac's window in front through its accessibility, Windows' through UI Automation.

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line in this call if another thread has the machine (default 4; 0 to not wait). When it runs out, your place in line is kept 3 minutes for your next call.

tools.name: machine_drive
tools.title: Drive a machine
tools.description: Click, type and press keys on a test machine's screen, waiting in line for your turn first. Steps are in each machine's own language, one per entry (machine_status says which). Pass capture: true to get a screenshot after. A step that lands in a sensitive app is undone at once, and the call says so.

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

capture.description: Return a screenshot after the steps.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line in this call if another thread has the machine (default 4; 0 to not wait). When it runs out, your place in line is kept 3 minutes for your next call.

tools.name: machine_run
tools.title: Run a command on a machine
tools.description: Run a command on a test machine. Plain commands (builds, headless tests, reading files and logs) run beside whoever has the machine; exclusive: true takes the machine's turn, for the app you're testing or anything on its screen. Returns the exit code and output. A command still running when the call has to answer, or started with background: true, goes on as a job that holds your turn until it ends: machine_job checks on it.

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

background.description: Start it and answer at once with its job id.

exclusive.description: Take the machine's turn for it.

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line in this call if another thread has the machine (default 4; 0 to not wait). When it runs out, your place in line is kept 3 minutes for your next call.

tools.name: machine_job
tools.title: A job of a machine
tools.description: Check on, wait for, or stop a command machine_run left running as a job. With no job, lists yours.

action.description: status (default), wait: until it ends, up to wait minutes; stop: end it.

tools.name: machine_app
tools.title: An app on a machine
tools.description: Start, bring forward, stop, install or uninstall an app on a test machine, or read a phone app's logs, waiting in line for your turn first where it touches the screen. kill: only apps you launched; never the user's. Sensitive apps (passwords, banking, payments, mail, messages, photos, health, the car, social posting, shopping) are refused.

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line in this call if another thread has the machine (default 4; 0 to not wait). When it runs out, your place in line is kept 3 minutes for your next call.

tools.name: machine_files
tools.title: Copy files to or from a machine
tools.description: Copy files to (put) or from (get) a test machine, waiting in line for your turn first. local is on this machine (absolute or ~/); remote ending in / is a folder.

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line in this call if another thread has the machine (default 4; 0 to not wait). When it runs out, your place in line is kept 3 minutes for your next call.

tools.name: machine_power
tools.title: Power a machine
tools.description: A machine's power or a phone's screen: on, off, reboot, or status (status needs no turn).

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line in this call if another thread has the machine (default 4; 0 to not wait). When it runs out, your place in line is kept 3 minutes for your next call.

tools.name: machine_record
tools.title: Record a machine's screen
tools.description: Record a test machine's screen while you do a flow: start, do the steps, then stop, which saves the video and gives a line to put in your reply that plays it in the thread. Takes your turn on the machine until you stop. Only for what a still can't show (an animation, a multi-step gesture); machine_capture for the rest.

machine.description: Which machine: its id, as machine_status lists them (with the bb driver: "mac", "windows", "linux", or a registered phone's id).

wait.description: Minutes to wait in line in this call if another thread has the machine (default 4; 0 to not wait). When it runs out, your place in line is kept 3 minutes for your next call.
